title: Source-hosted package
description: packages/<owner>/<name>/port.json — present only for packages whose maintained source lives in this repository. It carries what packing needs; the package-level record stays in package.json.

version.description: SemVer of the current source. Changing any file under src/ requires changing this, and the matching versions/<version>-r1.json must ship in the same pull request.

entry.description: Repository-relative, e.g. src/FindText.ks. The same path in every platform's artifact: a platform/<rid>/ overlay replaces files inside src/ rather than living beside it.

platforms.description: One artifact is built per entry, and a platform/<rid>/ directory must have its rid listed here or nothing in it would ever ship. A machine resolves the most specific artifact available, falling back architecture -> operating system -> any (linux-arm64, then linux, then any). Prefer the OS tier (win, linux, osx) for scripts, which vary by OS and not by architecture; use the architecture ids for native payloads, which do. Do not use 'any' as a stand-in for one platform: a machine whose OS you did not list will resolve it.

setup.description: A step the user must perform after installing. Printed by install; performed only by `kpm setup`, which shows the exact command and asks first. Carried through to every release manifest built from this port, whose schema defines the same shape — spelled out here rather than referenced across files, because a cross-file $ref makes validation fetch over the network.

message.description: What the step does and why, in plain language. Say so if it is risky.

script.description: Archive-relative path to something the package ships for this step. Must resolve inside the package: the path is untrusted input and cannot point elsewhere on the disk.

arguments.description: Arguments passed exactly as written. No shell, no expansion.

elevate.description: The step needs administrator rights; the user is told before confirming.

reboot.description: The step only takes effect after a restart.

platforms.description: Platforms the step applies to; omitted means all of them.

upstream.description: The revision this port was cut from, so a maintainer can diff against it later.
